newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Woo Bang, three other S.Korean IPOs begin trade.
newsitem.headline: Woo Bang, three other S.Korean IPOs begin trade.

text.p: Shares of Woo Bang Housing and Construction Co Ltd began trading for the first time at a base price of 12,900 won per share on Wednesday, the Korea Stock Exchange said.
Three other initial public offerings also began trading were: First Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd, at a base price of 7,600 won; Comtec Systems Co Ltd, at 42,000 won; and SJM Co Ltd, 27,000 won.
The base price is the weighted average of bids and offers received by the exchange and sets the trading range for the first day.
During the December 23-24 initial public offering, the subscription price for Woo Bang's 3.204 million shares had been set at 12,000 won.
The subscription price for First Mutual's 1.76 million shares was set at 6,300 won per share.
Comtec, a wireless telecommunications systems maker, saw a subscription price of 40,000 won for its 520,000 shares.
Auto parts maker SJM's subscription price for its 364,000 shares was set at 19,000 won per share.
